A340E(Others) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - OIL PUMP

If the body clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the drive gear, driven gear or pump body.

AT0154

2. CHECK TIP CLEARANCE OF DRIVEN GEAR
Measure between the driven gear teeth and the crescent-shaped part of the pump body.
Standard tip clearance:
0.11-0.14 mm (0.0043-0.0055 in.)
Maximum tip clearance:
0.3 mm (0.012 in.)
If the tip clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the drive gear, driven gear or pump body.

AT0155

3. CHECK SIDE CLEARANCE OF BOTH GEARS
Using a steel straight edge and a feeler gauge, measure the side clearance of both gears.
Standard side clearance:
0.02-0.05 mm (0.0008-0.0020 in.)
Maximum side clearance:
0.1 mm (0.004 in.)
If the side clearance is greater than the maximum, select and replace the gears as a set.
